name: Davidson Homes — Hidden Hills
heroHeadline: Their finishes, in their actual kitchen.
heroBody: This is your Hidden Hills kitchen with real upgrade selections wired up. Buyers pick finishes and see them in the room.
photoBaseline: Open-concept kitchen in a new-construction model home. Greige shaker-style cabinets on three walls (back wall with hood, left wall flanking pantry, right wall with French-door refrigerator) and on the large center island. White quartz countertops with subtle veining on perimeter and island, waterfall edge on island's near side. White subway tile backsplash on perimeter walls. Stainless steel appliances: range hood centered on back wall, double wall ovens to left of pantry, French-door refrigerator on right wall. Gold/brass hardware (bar pulls on all cabinets, gold faucet on island sink). Three brass dome pendant lights above island. Walk-in pantry with glass-paned French doors visible center-back, wine rack and open shelving inside. Light oak-toned LVP flooring throughout. White/off-white walls and vaulted ceiling with recessed lighting. Four upholstered barstools at island (staging). Staging items on countertops: cutting boards, framed art, glass jars, fruit bowl, canisters near fridge.
spatialHint: Large center island dominates the middle of the frame. CRITICAL: The island countertop is a WATERFALL design — one continuous slab of stone that flows seamlessly from the countertop surface over the edges and down the left and near-facing sides to the floor. There is NO seam, NO break, NO separate panel. The veining pattern and material continue uninterrupted from the top surface over the edge and down the sides. When changing countertop material, treat the top and sides as ONE continuous surface with consistent pattern flow. Back wall: range hood flanked by upper and lower greige shaker cabinets, white subway backsplash. Left of center: walk-in pantry with glass French doors, double wall ovens to its left. Right wall: French-door stainless refrigerator flanked by greige cabinets. Three brass dome pendants hang in a row above the island. Gold bar-pull hardware on all cabinet doors and drawers. Island has undermount sink with gold faucet. Four upholstered barstools line the near side of the island. Light oak LVP flooring visible around island and under barstools. Vaulted white ceiling with recessed can lights.

spatialHints.backsplash: wall areas with upper cabinets above and countertop below along the back wall, plus the wall behind and above the cooktop up to the chimney hood
spatialHints.counter-top: horizontal slab surfaces resting on the perimeter base cabinets, plus the top slab of the freestanding center structure and the short left end of that center structure where the slab wraps from the top down to the floor as a continuous waterfall panel
spatialHints.common-wall-paint: wall surfaces above the upper cabinets and on the vaulted ceiling area
spatialHints.kitchen-cabinet-color: upper and lower cabinet doors and drawer fronts along the left wall, the back wall on both sides of the range hood, and the right wall on both sides of the refrigerator
spatialHints.main-area-flooring-color: LVP plank flooring visible around the island base and between cabinets
